_comment: Reference values for lammps-restart-continue. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-restart-continue:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022).
_calibration_note: Restart written after 1000 NVT steps (seed 99999); 2000-step NVE continuation is deterministic — 5 oracle runs identical. Tolerances at physical minimum resolution 0.001. L4 run-0 PE of final.data reproduces the log last line to print precision; tol 1e-4.
